title: Path of Exile 2 0.5.2 — Endgame, Runes of Aldur and Delirium
summary: 0.5.2 focused on Endgame Atlas, Delirium, Runes of Aldur rewards, Catalyst and controller UI. This page reorganises those changes by player impact.
description: A balance patch page for 0.5.2. It covers Atlas rewards, Delirium difficulty, Runes of Aldur and the controller UI changes without duplicating the official notes.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: A storm-darkened ruined city representing the 0.5.2 Endgame and Runes update

sections.title: Player impact in 30 seconds
paragraphs: 0.5.2 was a balance patch centred on Endgame Atlas, Delirium, Runes of Aldur rewards, Catalyst and controller UI.
The biggest re-checks are Endgame route Guides (rewards changed), Delirium difficulty Guides, and any Runes of Aldur page that cited old reward values.
Controller players got UI improvements that change how some menus are navigated.

versions.summary: Base Endgame and Runes of Aldur systems that 0.5.2 adjusted.
Atlas passive and Runes QoL groundwork before 0.5.2.
Endgame Atlas, Delirium, Runes of Aldur rewards, Catalyst and controller UI on this page.

cards.detail: Atlas reward tuning changed which maps and passives are worth farming.
Delirium ladder and reward scaling adjusted; old difficulty Guides are stale.
Runes of Aldur reward tuning affects any page that cited old values.
Controller players should re-learn a few menus after the UI changes.

items.question: Did 0.5.2 add content?
answer: No. 0.5.2 is a balance patch for existing Endgame, Delirium, Runes of Aldur and Catalyst systems.
It tunes rewards and difficulty rather than adding new systems.

items.question: Which Guides are most affected?
answer: Endgame Atlas and Delirium Guides need reward and difficulty re-checks.
Runes of Aldur and Catalyst pages need value updates.

issues.text: Controller UI changes still being documented on the Controller Guide.
Some Delirium threshold reports varied by build; not yet a single confirmed value.
